title: GOAL Phase I: Orchestrator efficiency and Jev decision layer — P0 current-version token/cost/outcome attribution and efficiency metrics (tokens per accepted task/goal, tokens to first green, first-pass and fix-round rates, pipeline amplification, preserved baselines), then in order P1 role-specific context packets and dedup, P2 fix-round economics in the scorecard, P3 Jev executor classification in shadow mode, P4 shadow evaluation, P5 active routing only on evidence, P6 review packet and complementary-review optimization, P7 independent Jev decision-point experiments; safety invariants deterministic
spec: Program brief: .orchestrator/phase-i-program.md (the user's full text, 2026-09-20 17:30). Build on goal/T-0353 (Phase H, PR 12) once it is open; goal branch goal/<this id> cut from its head. Owner: the registered Planner session (launcher process 7155); session 6410 finishes Phase H only. Phases are separate task clusters; P0 telemetry must merge and produce a measured baseline before P3+ changes any production behaviour; P5 only with shadow evidence; P6 only with P0 review telemetry; each P7 experiment is its own task. Every phase ends with a measured comparison against the previous baseline recorded in memory.
acceptance: P0 merged: scorecard exposes tokens and cost per accepted task and goal, tokens and time to first green, first-pass success rate, fix-round rate and average, fix-round tokens, calls and turns per accepted task, model distribution, pipeline amplification with the role breakdown, attribution by task, goal, role, executor, complexity band and task type, unknown usage as its own bucket; a stored baseline snapshot for the current architecture with tests for each metric

P1 merged: deterministic role packets for executor, review, scout and spec review that contain the required inputs and exclude unrelated state, stale-context invalidation, progressive memory recall that stops when sufficient; input-token sizes by role recorded before and after

P2 merged: scorecard per executor and complexity band reports first-pass green rate, fix-round probability, average fix rounds, tokens and cost to accepted task, gate failure reasons, review request_changes rate; fix rounds keep Codex resume

P3 and P4 merged: Jev classification before executor selection in shadow mode only, hard constraints authoritative, no Jev call when it cannot change the decision, fail-open, batched typed questions, cached and invalidated classifications, and telemetry rows recording baseline vs hypothetical executor with outcomes; tests cover the full routing matrix
P5, P6, P7 each gated on the evidence the brief names and each introduced by its own task; the safety invariants have tests showing Jev cannot bypass pool or merge constraints
Each phase's measurement recorded in memory with the revert path; PR goal/<id> to main listing PR 12 as base
